### Healer of the Broken
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/healer-of-the-broken-girlfriends-in-god-july-19-2013.html
Passage: Psalm 147:3
Points:
- Walking alongside friends in distress provides vital opportunities to point them back to Christ.
- Suffering often causes people to feel isolated and wonder if God truly hears their cries.
- Believers can take comfort in knowing that the Lord sees their heartache and never wastes their pain.
- Christ meets hurting individuals directly in their brokenness to bring peace, comfort, and healing.
